meta.label: FS Cleanup
meta.description: Scan and delete policy-scoped filesystem debris under DIP_HOME (webapp run directories first). Roots, age gates, keep-newest-N and running-webapp exclusions are enforced inside this macro.

params.name: policy
params.label: Policy
params.description: Which cleanup policy to apply (currently: webappruns).

params.name: project_key
params.label: Project key
params.description: Restrict to one project's webapp run dirs. Empty = all projects.

params.name: min_age_days
params.label: Minimum age (days)
params.description: Only run directories whose newest content is older than this are eligible.

params.name: keep_last_runs
params.label: Keep newest runs
params.description: Per webapp, always keep this many newest run directories.

params.name: max_delete_gb
params.label: Delete cap (GB)
params.description: Abort if the delete candidates exceed this total size.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run
params.description: When true, list what would be deleted without deleting.
